scope: Final local verification entrypoint for the ten-second AC-WM delivery
summary: The direct .venv/bin/pytest launcher failed during collection because its stale shebang invoked Homebrew Python 3.14 without the project import path. The corrected interpreter-explicit command passed the complete suite, so this is an environment-entrypoint failure with successful code verification, not a product-test failure.
evidence: The first command reported 65 collection errors, all ModuleNotFoundError for phiagent or scripts, before executing any test.
PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q completed with 363 passed and one optional MuJoCo skip in 4.69 seconds.
The interpreter-explicit Ruff check passed for every changed Python module and test; git diff --check also passed.
Both published JSON files parse, and every new minimax-h3-long poster/video reference in demo/index.html resolves to a nonempty local file.
lessons: Use the environment's Python module invocation for reproducible tests when a copied or moved virtual environment can leave console-script shebangs stale.
A collection-environment failure must not be reported as a code regression, but it must still be preserved as an engineering attempt.
limitations: MuJoCo is not installed in the local CPU environment, so its optional backend test remains skipped.

The stale pytest console-script entrypoint was diagnosed but not rewritten because environment repair is outside the requested long-action implementation and the interpreter-explicit route is reproducible.
next_actions: Recreate the local virtual environment if direct console-script entrypoints are required by a future automation runner.
